mapper.insert: insert into wkf_schedule (id, tenant_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by, version, organization_id, name, status_enum, active_flag, planning_horizon_start, planning_horizon_end, service_type_concept_json, healthcare_service_id, service_category_json, specialty_json, comment_markdown, substitute_practitioner_id, substitute_reason, source_schedule_template_id, slot_provision_template_id) values ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{isDeleted}, #{deletedAt}, #{deletedBy}, #{version}, #{organizationId}, #{name}, #{statusEnum}, #{activeFlag}, #{planningHorizonStart}, #{planningHorizonEnd}, #{serviceTypeConceptJson}, #{healthcareServiceId}, #{serviceCategoryJson}, #{specialtyJson}, #{commentMarkdown}, #{substitutePractitionerId}, #{substituteReason}, #{sourceScheduleTemplateId}, #{slotProvisionTemplateId} );
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) AS scheduleId, s.name AS name, s.status_enum AS statusEnum, s.planning_horizon_start AS planningHorizonStart, s.planning_horizon_end AS planningHorizonEnd, s.healthcare_service_id AS healthcareServiceId, s.source_schedule_template_id AS sourceScheduleTemplateId, s.slot_provision_template_id AS slotProvisionTemplateId, s.substitute_practitioner_id AS substitutePractitionerId, NULL AS fromTemplate, NULL AS weekScheduleTemplateId, NULL AS dayScheduleTemplateId, NULL AS bookable, NULL AS originalPractitionerId, NULL AS substituteDisplay, NULL AS practitionerName, NULL AS locationName, NULL AS healthcareServiceName FROM wkf_schedule s WHERE s.id = #{scheduleId}
